secrets.name: DEEPSEEK_API_KEY
secrets.description: DeepSeek API key (platform.deepseek.com → API keys) — powers all AI chat/generation. App boots without it but every AI feature refuses.

secrets.name: SUPABASE_URL
secrets.description: Supabase project URL (supabase.com → Settings → API) — required for login/signup to work; without it the app renders but accounts can't be created.

secrets.name: SUPABASE_SERVICE_KEY
secrets.description: Supabase service-role key (supabase.com → Settings → API) — pairs with SUPABASE_URL.

secrets.name: COMPOSIO_API_KEY
secrets.description: Composio API key (app.composio.dev) — enables the Gmail/Calendar/Drive connect flows.

secrets.name: CREDENTIAL_ENCRYPTION_KEY
secrets.description: 32-byte hex key (openssl rand -hex 32) — encrypts stored credentials like the Pronote token. Dev boots without it (plaintext, warned).

secrets.name: SESSION_SECRET
secrets.description: Random string for cookie-session signing. Dev boots without it; required in production.
